up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), molecule name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), and indication details (mesh_heading, efo_term) for all approved drugs indicated for cardiovascular disease. Filter molecule_dictionary where max_phase = 4. Filter drug_indication where mesh_heading or efo_term contains 'cardiovascular' (case-insensitive). Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno, and molecule_dictionary with compound_structures on molregno. Return one row per compound-indication match.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%cardiovascular%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%cardiovascular%')
